policy: Run focused compilation and boundary checks during implementation. Independent testing and checked global proofs remain required for final acceptance.

obligations.required: Run the new comparator session against a real digest-pinned Linux producer and pinned actual kernel providers, exercise hostile exports and runtime escape/cleanup cases, and supply provider/runtime hardening evidence. Current decoder/session tests use mock kernels and container orchestration; no formal theorem or real sandbox assurance follows.

Exercise the actual generated compiler and pinned provider through production checked service, cross-session replay, policy mutation, rejection, target routing, revocation and closure; audit every production import path.
Lean-check the semantic environment model, full algorithmic-defeq soundness, cache refinement and checker soundness, with explicit theory and assumption closure.

Lean-check global erasure/specialization preservation, or independently validate every actual transformation under a precisely declared supported contract. The host specialization correspondence checker now covers all encoded expression constructors and checks actual staged JS/archived instances independently of producer name mangling. Strict source/output validity and adequacy for runtime semantics remain preconditions; global validator soundness and erasure preservation are unproved. Run whole-compiler and adversarial campaigns; local slices do not discharge this obligation.

Check complete supported backend semantics, differential/adversarial corpora, artifact validators and ABI adapters; unsupported slices must fail closed. JavaScript now lowers saturated decreasing-worker aliases to loops with frozen captures and immutable iteration parameters; focused source/printer execution and the portable round-trip contract pass. Global preservation and the actual whole-compiler fixed point remain separate obligations.

Produce B9 diverse bootstrap and B10 verified bootstrap evidence with actual toolchain independence vectors and artifact identities.
Exercise all declared resource limits, cancellation, malformed inputs, cycles, large/deep certificates, cache poisoning and small-to-larger budget behavior; prove monotonicity only if Lean checks it.

Replay actual compiler-preservation proof/validator certificates, trust closure and pinned release archives offline; metadata/hash closure is insufficient. A standalone pinned Lean Wasm profile checks a real closed implication-identity proof and rejects an invalid proof outside the checkout. A scoped SAVEF operation now replays actual Wasm literal certificates and records real artifact reuse only after fresh output validation, including actual PSC-emitted bytes. These focused fixtures do not discharge source preservation, broader theorem/interface reuse, diverse checking, runtime hardening, signed release or global assurance obligations.
Freeze and seal actual tasks independently, run all ablations and resource accounting, and publish reproducible evidence without making holdout searchable to the factory.
Assess every V3 acceptance criterion using actual artifacts, independent validators or Lean-checked theorems as required; milestone source scans are not final evidence.

Bind actual source/destination checked admissions and canonical artifacts to the portable closed-renaming validator, replay its relation through a registered independent checker, and Lean-check preservation. Current 19 executable cases and PSC1 source/emission parity establish no global theorem; cross-foundation morphisms and general inductive/proof translations remain unsupported.

Check emitted WIT with an independent pinned Component Model parser, implement actual target runtime adapters and bind them to validated modules/artifacts, then exercise canonical ABI behavior, ownership/lifetimes, capability confinement and async cancellation. Portable structural checks and the 17-case WIT fixture do not establish runtime ABI behavior or global adapter soundness.
